title: Manage your tow truck driver certificate
summary: This page provides information on how to manage, renew, or replace your tow truck driver certificate in NSW.
who_can_apply: Must be a tow truck driver in NSW.
what_you_need: Completed PDF form for renewal or replacement.
Photocopy of your unrestricted Australian driver licence (front and back).
Payment receipt number from the payment portal.

more_info.text: visit the NSW Fair Trading website – Driving or operating a tow truck in NSW
For more information on tow truck driver certificates:

faqs.q: What do I need to do if I am renewing my certificate?
faqs.a: You must complete the PDF form, provide a photocopy of your unrestricted Australian driver licence (front and back), and enter the payment receipt number on the form after making the renewal payment through the payment portal.

faqs.q: What happens if my certificate has expired?
faqs.a: The page mentions a section for 'If your certificate has expired' but does not provide specific instructions.

faqs.q: How do I replace my tow truck driver certificate?
faqs.a: You need to complete the PDF application form, provide a photocopy of your unrestricted Australian driver licence (front and back), and enter the payment receipt number on the form after making the renewal payment through the payment portal.
